lines.t: (Verse 1)
With their heads bowed low, they walk the street
Blind to the truth, and swift on their feet
To commit violence against their neighbor today
They make their plans, and they turn away
But you see them, oh you see them
They devise evil schemes in the dark
With no spark.
(Chorus)
The love of man has grown cold, grown cold
The heart of man is so wicked and old
In their heads, in their heads, they are sleeping
Captives, captives, captives-v-v
What’s in their heads, in their heads, they are weeping
Captives, captives, captives-v-v, oh, oh, oh, oh, v-v, oh, oh
(Verse 2)
They murder the innocent without a cause
They rob the poor and break all Your laws
Behold, they dismember the helpless right there
And the heartless applaud them, they don’t even care
And every night, oh every night
They love to lie down in abominations
In all the nations.
(Chorus)
The love of man has grown cold, grown cold
The heart of man is so wicked and old
In their heads, in their heads, they are sleeping
Captives, captives, captives-v-v
What’s in their heads, in their heads, they are weeping
Captives, captives, captives-v-v, oh, oh, oh, oh, v-v, oh, oh
(Bridge / Outro)
But the Lord is returning soon, returning soon!
Breaking the night, breaking the gloom!
Their hands work evil every day
But His judgment is on the way!
In their heads, in their heads, they’re still sleeping
Captives, captives, captives-v-v-v, oh!
